interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your study habits during school?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to study effectively?
Q3: In your opinion, what makes a study habit effective?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone struggling with their study habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise and health.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever faced any obstacles to staying active?
Q3: How important do you believe exercise is for overall health?
Q4: What tips would you give someone who wants to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteering.
questions: Q1: Have you ever volunteered for a community service project?
Q2: What difficulties did you encounter while volunteering?
Q3: Why do you think volunteering is valuable for individuals and communities?
Q4: What encouragement would you offer to someone considering volunteering?
